detail: Begin distributing vaccine to administration sites—about four months before the simulated onset.
Start the vaccination campaign while incidence remains near the summer baseline.
Aim to reach maximum vaccine uptake before the surveillance onset threshold is crossed.
Confirm antiviral supply and distribute stock to outpatient and acute-care sites.
The simulated national curve first exceeds the plausible surveillance onset threshold.
Reinforce hand hygiene, staying home when ill, masking when appropriate, and avoiding crowded indoor exposure.
Redistribute staffing, beds, diagnostics, and supplies toward regions experiencing the greatest burden.
Communicate that cases may be turning while asking the public and health systems to sustain effective interventions.
Early vaccine-effectiveness estimates become available after most vaccination-timing decisions are already complete.
Select the Northern Hemisphere vaccine strain for the next influenza season.
